name: Khronon-Adorned Pure F+ Nonlocal MOND
claimed_mechanism: This architecture pairs a genuinely nonlocal spatial F+ operator (which enforces the exact mu=1-e^-y MOND force law globally without localizing) with a degenerate khronon field. The khronon is endowed with an unscreened, finite kinetic normalization derived from the squared physical acceleration a_mu a^mu, decoupling it completely from the e^-y screened preferred-frame PPN response. By allowing the khronon to acquire an acceleration-squared mass, its longitudinal mode is gapped at macroscopic scales, cleanly bypassing the P7 strong-coupling wall that destroyed the previous khronometric MOND attempts while preserving a finite alpha_2.
predicted_weak_field: In the weak-field limit, the spatially nonlocal F+ operator generates the exact MONDian acceleration, while the degenerate khronon acts as a rigid frame that mediates the Phi=Psi lensing relation (evading the DC-013 slip-lock theorem). The screened e^-y coupling to the matter sector ensures PPN parameters like alpha_1 and alpha_2 vanish exponentially in the Solar System (y >> 1), while the unscreened acceleration-squared mass keeps the propagating khronon mode firmly gapped (no strong coupling) and strictly subluminal, maintaining c_T=1.
inequivalence_argument: This candidate escapes DC-001, DC-012, and DC-013 by explicitly relying on a preferred-frame khronon carrier to achieve correct MOND lensing, which the frame-free slip-lock theorem proved impossible. It escapes the DC-010 khronometric closure and P7 by separating the e^-y screened PPN coupling from an independent, unscreened acceleration-squared kinetic normalization, preventing the vanishing kinetic limit. It is structurally distinct from all killed spatially-nonlocal candidates (which failed at P7 via stiff-vector longitudinal modes) by using a nonlocal F+ kernel as the constitutive MOND driver and a gapped degenerate khronon as the lensing frame.
